name: Topology-Aware Anchor Feature Aggregation
definition: A mechanism for aggregating features across different levels of a hierarchical anchor structure to improve texture and edge consistency in large-scale 3D Gaussian Splatting, addressing feature isolation.
summary: Topology-Aware Anchor Feature Aggregation improves texture consistency in 3D Gaussian Splatting by enforcing topological containment relations between hierarchical anchors, ensuring feature aggregation respects spatial hierarchy rather than treating nearby anchors equally.
